title: Fix label-versus-destination mismatches in nav, brief signals, hub Workflows, and headline figures
acceptance_criteria: Systematic enumeration of label-versus-destination mismatches across (1) navConfig rail leaves, (2) brief/signals action_label vs action_href (Attention on /brief and Overview hub), (3) hub Workflows PanelRow hrefs, (4) headline-figure click targets. Record every instance in implementer evidence. Origin: 2026-09-13 discovery on this branch (D-0010 rail vs tabs plus live brief signals). Do not limit the node to named cases.

Cover-breach attention title grain is under 4 weeks of cover. Destination must be the Cover lens with a real under-4w filter (union of existing under-2w and 2-4w chips), not /sell-out and not Movement. soh_recon_not_run labelled Open Stock · Cover must also open Cover (lens only).
Failed-imports signal keeps the steward-queue label; href must open the steward queue (/admin/mappings), not Import Center failed jobs.
Inbound-open signal label corrected to Supply; href is /supply/shipments with no /shipping redirect hop.

Lineup cases: rail leaf, Planning hub headline figure, and Workflows row all open /lineup/cases. Users & roles rail opens /admin/users/list, not the Administration hub. Any other enumerated mismatch of the same class is fixed in this node.

Every fix is verified by rendering the source surface, clicking the control, and confirming the final URL. Playwright MCP only. Do not use browser_cdp. NUMBER RULE does not apply (destinations, not headline values).

Do not restructure navigation. Do not remove rail expansion or tabs — D-0010 Option A is accepted. Do not unwind relocated workspaces under Movement and Execution. Do not touch D-0002, N-0006, N-0013, or BACKLOG-181. Do not consolidate column pickers or grid chrome. Do not cite a frozen design-language version or grammar number.
Independent GOV-008 vs this node's implementation_run is a later session under a different run and actor. Do not complete this node in the implementation run.
